Name: Content Patcher - Ornamental Shrimp
Author: seasIug
Description:
Gives shrimp new, alive sprites. Choose one from 44 sprites based on freshwater shrimp morphs.

You can toggle floating or bottom feeder animations for aquariums, and choose to find shrimp in saltwater or freshwater.

A massive thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/177391248]otohimexoxo[/url]﻿ for fixing the aquarium frames, and making the planned Json Assets conversion possible!
